svg.metadata: {"id": "s060", "name": "编织手工台", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["劳动", "手工", "编织", "传统工艺"], "desc": "温馨的编织手工角：墙上挂着木框织布机（彩色经纬条纹）、毛线格子柜与红色中国结，长桌上毛线团、正在编织的围巾、刺绣绷和藤编篮。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "loom", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "yarn_cubbies", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "chinese_knot", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.55, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "pompoms", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "table", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "table_items", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor_basket", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#FBE6E2", "wall2": "#F2D0CA", "stripe": "#F6DAD4", "wood": "#D9A873", "wood2": "#B9824E", "table": "#E8BE8A", "table2": "#C99A62", "y1": "#F28B82", "y2": "#F7C55E", "y3": "#7FC7B8", "y4": "#8FA8E6", "y5": "#C49BE0", "y6": "#9ED27C", "y7": "#F7A86A", "cream": "#FFF7EC", "red": "#D8423A", "red2": "#B8312B", "gold": "#F2C14E", "basket": "#D2A266", "basket2": "#AE7E46", "hoop": "#C99A62", "linen": "#FFFBF2", "leaf": "#6DB57E", "floor1": "#D9B48C", "floor2": "#C29C72", "lamp": "#FFE3A3"}}
